name: context-meter
description: How much of a model’s context window a conversation has used — "12K / 200K" with a bar that warns as it fills

meta.name: ContextMeter
meta.description: How much of a model’s context window a conversation has used — "12K / 200K" with a bar that warns as it fills

props.name: max
props.description: The context window size, in tokens.

props.name: label
props.description: The meter’s name, shown above the bar.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n). `usage` is the spoken value and may contain `{used}`, `{max}` and `{percent}`.

whenToUse: Showing how much of the model’s context window a conversation or document has used
Warning before a conversation hits the limit and older turns are dropped
whenNotToUse: Task progress toward completion — use ProgressBar
Account-level usage and billing quotas with many figures — use Stat or a chart

antiPatterns.bad: Colour alone to signal the window is nearly full
antiPatterns.good: Keep the "used / max" figures visible; colour reinforces them
antiPatterns.why: Colour is not perceivable by everyone; the numbers carry the meaning

related.name: ProgressBar
related.reason: ProgressBar is for progress toward done; a meter measures a level within a range

related.name: AiStatus
related.reason: Both sit in an AI chat’s header or footer

intent.a11yRationale: role="meter" with aria-valuenow/min/max and an aria-valuetext in full words ("12,400 of 200,000 tokens used (6%)"), named by its label. The compact visible line is aria-hidden so it is not read twice. Colour steps to warning at 80% and destructive at 95%, but the figures always carry the meaning

flexibility.note: Rename via label; reword via labels.usage
Warning at 80%, full at 95% — consistent across every meter
